title: Attribute Convention for Data Discovery (ACDD) 1.3
description: Discovery attributes of the Attribute Convention for Data Discovery 1.3 by ESIP (https://wiki.esipfed.org/Attribute_Convention_for_Data_Discovery_1-3) for netCDF and Zarr. Datasets declare it with `ACDD-1.3` in their global `Conventions` attribute. The descriptions summarise the convention; see it for the complete guidance. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes of a netCDF or Zarr group (global attributes on the root group) or variable.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short phrase or sentence describing the dataset, as shown in search results. Highly recommended. Global attribute.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Paragraph describing the dataset, like the abstract of a paper. Highly recommended. Global attribute.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords or phrases, possibly terms or URIs of a controlled vocabulary named in `keywords_vocabulary`. Highly recommended. Global attribute.

Conventions.title: Conventions
Conventions.description: Comma-separated list of conventions followed; includes `ACDD-1.3` for this version. Highly recommended. Global attribute.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Identifier of the dataset, unique within its naming authority, without white space. Recommended. Global attribute.

naming_authority.title: Naming authority
naming_authority.description: Organisation that provides the identifier, preferably in reverse-DNS form such as `edu.ucar.unidata`. Recommended. Global attribute.

history.title: History
history.description: Audit trail of the modifications of the original data, one line per processing step. Recommended. Global attribute.

source.title: Source
source.description: How the original data were produced: the model and its version or the observation method. Recommended. Global attribute.

processing_level.title: Processing level
processing_level.description: Textual description of the processing or quality-control level of the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Miscellaneous information about the data or the methods used to produce it. Recommended. Global attribute.

acknowledgement.title: Acknowledgement
acknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement of the various types of support for the project that produced the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

license.title: Licence
license.description: Licence of the data: the URL of a standard or specific licence, "Freely Distributed", "None", or a free-text description of restrictions. Recommended. Global attribute.

standard_name_vocabulary.title: Standard name vocabulary
standard_name_vocabulary.description: Name and version of the vocabulary of the `standard_name` attributes, for example `CF Standard Name Table v84`. Recommended. Global attribute.

date_created.title: Date created
date_created.description: When this version of the data was created, in ISO 8601 format. Recommended. Global attribute.

creator_name.title: Creator name
creator_name.description: Name of the person or other creator principally responsible for creating the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

creator_email.title: Creator email
creator_email.description: Email address of the creator. Recommended. Global attribute.

creator_url.title: Creator URL
creator_url.description: Web address of the creator. Recommended. Global attribute.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: Name of the institution principally responsible for the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

project.title: Project
project.description: Name of the scientific project or projects that produced the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

publisher_name.title: Publisher name
publisher_name.description: Name of the person or organisation that distributes the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

publisher_email.title: Publisher email
publisher_email.description: Email address of the publisher. Recommended. Global attribute.

publisher_url.title: Publisher URL
publisher_url.description: Web address of the publisher. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_bounds.title: Geospatial bounds
geospatial_bounds.description: Footprint of the data as Well-Known Text (WKT), in the CRS of `geospatial_bounds_crs`. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_bounds_crs.title: Geospatial bounds CRS
geospatial_bounds_crs.description: Coordinate reference system of `geospatial_bounds`, preferably an EPSG code such as `EPSG:4326`. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_bounds_vertical_crs.title: Geospatial bounds vertical CRS
geospatial_bounds_vertical_crs.description: Vertical coordinate reference system of the vertical values of `geospatial_bounds`. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_lat_min.title: Southernmost latitude
geospatial_lat_min.description: Southernmost latitude of the data, in decimal degrees north. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_lat_max.title: Northernmost latitude
geospatial_lat_max.description: Northernmost latitude of the data, in decimal degrees north. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_lon_min.title: Westernmost longitude
geospatial_lon_min.description: Westernmost longitude of the data, in decimal degrees east. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_lon_max.title: Easternmost longitude
geospatial_lon_max.description: Easternmost longitude of the data, in decimal degrees east. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_vertical_min.title: Lowest vertical value
geospatial_vertical_min.description: Smallest vertical coordinate of the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_vertical_max.title: Highest vertical value
geospatial_vertical_max.description: Largest vertical coordinate of the data. Recommended. Global attribute.

geospatial_vertical_positive.title: Vertical positive direction
geospatial_vertical_positive.description: Whether vertical values increase upwards or downwards. Recommended. Global attribute.

time_coverage_start.title: Time coverage start
time_coverage_start.description: Start of the time period of the data, in ISO 8601 format. Recommended. Global attribute.

time_coverage_end.title: Time coverage end
time_coverage_end.description: End of the time period of the data, in ISO 8601 format. Recommended. Global attribute.

time_coverage_duration.title: Time coverage duration
time_coverage_duration.description: Duration of the time period of the data, as an ISO 8601 duration. Recommended. Global attribute.

time_coverage_resolution.title: Time coverage resolution
time_coverage_resolution.description: Target time interval between data values, as an ISO 8601 duration. Recommended. Global attribute.

creator_type.title: Creator type
creator_type.description: Kind of creator named in `creator_name`. Suggested. Global attribute.

creator_institution.title: Creator institution
creator_institution.description: Institution of the creator. Suggested. Global attribute.

publisher_type.title: Publisher type
publisher_type.description: Kind of publisher named in `publisher_name`. Suggested. Global attribute.

publisher_institution.title: Publisher institution
publisher_institution.description: Institution of the publisher. Suggested. Global attribute.

program.title: Programme
program.description: Overarching programme or programmes of which the dataset is a part. Suggested. Global attribute.

contributor_name.title: Contributor names
contributor_name.description: Names of individuals, institutions or projects that contributed to the data, separated by commas. Suggested. Global attribute.

contributor_role.title: Contributor roles
contributor_role.description: Roles of the contributors, in the order of `contributor_name`. Suggested. Global attribute.

geospatial_lat_units.title: Latitude units
geospatial_lat_units.description: Units of the latitude values; `degree_north` by default. Suggested. Global attribute.

geospatial_lat_resolution.title: Latitude resolution
geospatial_lat_resolution.description: Target spacing of the data in latitude, with units. Suggested. Global attribute.

geospatial_lon_units.title: Longitude units
geospatial_lon_units.description: Units of the longitude values; `degree_east` by default. Suggested. Global attribute.

geospatial_lon_resolution.title: Longitude resolution
geospatial_lon_resolution.description: Target spacing of the data in longitude, with units. Suggested. Global attribute.

geospatial_vertical_units.title: Vertical units
geospatial_vertical_units.description: Units of the vertical values, or an EPSG code of a vertical CRS. Suggested. Global attribute.

geospatial_vertical_resolution.title: Vertical resolution
geospatial_vertical_resolution.description: Target vertical spacing of the data, with units. Suggested. Global attribute.

date_modified.title: Date modified
date_modified.description: When the data were last modified, in ISO 8601 format. Suggested. Global attribute.

date_issued.title: Date issued
date_issued.description: When the data were first made available, in ISO 8601 format. Suggested. Global attribute.

date_metadata_modified.title: Metadata modification date
date_metadata_modified.description: When the metadata were last modified, in ISO 8601 format. Suggested. Global attribute.

product_version.title: Product version
product_version.description: Version of the product or processing that produced the data. Suggested. Global attribute.

keywords_vocabulary.title: Keywords vocabulary
keywords_vocabulary.description: Controlled vocabulary or vocabularies of the `keywords`, for example `GCMD:GCMD Keywords`. Suggested. Global attribute.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Names of the platforms that supported the sensors, such as satellites or ships, separated by commas. Suggested. Global attribute.

platform_vocabulary.title: Platform vocabulary
platform_vocabulary.description: Controlled vocabulary of the `platform` names. Suggested. Global attribute.

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: Names of the instruments or sensors that collected the data, separated by commas. Suggested. Global attribute.

instrument_vocabulary.title: Instrument vocabulary
instrument_vocabulary.description: Controlled vocabulary of the `instrument` names. Suggested. Global attribute.

cdm_data_type.title: CDM data type
cdm_data_type.description: Data type according to the Unidata Common Data Model (THREDDS). Suggested. Global attribute.

metadata_link.title: Metadata link
metadata_link.description: URL of a complete metadata record of the data, such as an ISO 19115 record. Suggested. Global attribute.

references.title: References
references.description: Published or web-based references that describe the data or the methods used to produce it. Suggested. Global attribute.

long_name.title: Long name
long_name.description: Descriptive name of the variable, as for CF. Highly recommended. Variable attribute.

standard_name.title: Standard name
standard_name.description: Name from the CF standard name table that identifies the quantity. Highly recommended. Variable attribute.

units.title: Units
units.description: Units of the variable, as for CF. Highly recommended. Variable attribute.

coverage_content_type.title: Coverage content type
coverage_content_type.description: ISO 19115 coverage content type of the variable. Highly recommended. Variable attribute.

oneOf.title: Auxiliary information
oneOf.description: Supporting information, such as a sensor angle.

oneOf.title: Quality information
oneOf.description: Quality flags or uncertainty of other variables.

oneOf.title: Reference information
oneOf.description: Reference data, such as a land mask.
